species_review.name: Screegrin
species_review.description: Its cheerful chatter carries down the slopes as it gathers smooth stones for its den.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, the chatter and the gathered stones have become a den that sings down the slope.

species_review.name: Screehold
species_review.description: It still knows which stones will slide, and now it pins them until the herd is past.

species_review.name: Screehowl
species_review.description: The chatter and the gathered stones have become a den that sings down the slope.

species_review.name: Seedmoth
species_review.description: It shelters one seed under a wing and dries it over the warm ash of Emberfall Highlands. The wing is still too small to be a garden.

evolutions.hint: Once it has grown, warm ash crusts the wings it is trying to open.

species_review.name: Seedpip
species_review.description: In Thornwood, it tucks fallen seeds into fence cracks and checks them again after rain.

species_review.name: Seedshroud
species_review.description: The dusk web that caught seeds now plants them, and a dark garden follows it.

species_review.name: Shalecat
species_review.description: It naps on loose scree and knows, before anyone, which stones are about to slide.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, it still knows which stones will slide, and now it pins them until the herd is past.

species_review.name: Shellsong
species_review.description: The notes it tapped on shells have become a clear song before dawn.

species_review.name: Shoalcrest
species_review.description: Its ridged back parts the surf into calm channels where smaller creatures can cross.

species_review.name: Shoalpup
species_review.description: It waits at the tideline until every returning paw has reached dry sand.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you deeply and has grown, the wait at the tideline becomes a howl that calls everyone home.

species_review.name: Silentmane
species_review.description: The silent hunt has become a mane that swallows its own footsteps.

species_review.name: Siltjaw
species_review.description: It rests under grey-green water with only its mossy nose above the surface.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, the mossy nose under the water has risen into a reed-crowned head the channel knows.

species_review.name: Slaglet
species_review.description: It rolls in warm volcanic dust until its coat forms a snug crust that keeps out the mountain chill.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, the dust-crust becomes a kiln.

species_review.name: Slatehoof
species_review.description: Its broad hooves test each ledge before it lets the rest of the herd follow.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, the hooves that tested each ledge have become the path the herd walks.

species_review.name: Smoulderpup
species_review.description: A lanky young wolf, always too warm to hold. Glowing cracks run down its spine, and it steams when the rain finds it.

evolutions.hint: The fire breathes once it has grown, and only for a tamer it trusts.

species_review.name: Sootcloak
species_review.description: Ash has crusted the wings it meant to open. It drags them, heavy and lopsided, and it still keeps that one seed warm.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you deeply and has grown, the crust splits and the wings open like a garden.

species_review.name: Soundhowl
species_review.description: Its low call passes along the shore, letting separated teams find the same sheltered inlet.

species_review.name: Spindriftfoal
species_review.description: It races along the waterline, scattering ribbons of sea spray with every stride.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, the ribbons of spray have become a mane that the shoreline follows.

species_review.name: Spraymane
species_review.description: The ribbons of spray have become a mane that the shoreline follows.

species_review.name: Stillmaw
species_review.description: The long wait in the water has become a pool that stays quiet around it.

species_review.name: Stillwake
species_review.description: Stillreed Basin's guardian shelters small creatures in its calm wake as flooded channels carry them across.

species_review.name: Stormfrill
species_review.description: Cloudglass Pass's storm winds bend its great frill, but it folds the sail to shelter its companions from the worst gusts.

species_review.name: Stormkite
species_review.description: It still rides the breeze without flapping, and the storm answers its whistle.

species_review.name: Sunford
species_review.description: The spark became a mane of morning. Where it steps through a ford, the water lights, and people follow the bright hooves home.

species_review.name: Sunfrill
species_review.description: Sunthread Commons's fence rails are its sunny resting places; its bright sail shades the little creatures gathered underneath.

species_review.name: Sunlynx
species_review.description: A Poolkit that grew up devoted to its tamer. Its coat holds the morning light, and it lies across the doorway at night to keep it in.

species_review.name: Sunspark
species_review.description: A rare spark of living light. Seeing one is said to be good luck.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you a little and has grown, the lucky spark has opened into a flare that stays with the people who saw it.

species_review.name: Thermglide
species_review.description: The circling call has become a long glide that shows every sheltered ledge.

species_review.name: Thermwing
species_review.description: It circles on rising warmth, calling out sheltered ledges to the creatures climbing below.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, the circling call has become a long glide that shows every sheltered ledge.

species_review.name: Thicketboar
species_review.description: Burly and shaggy, and the garden on its back has not settled. Saplings sprout lopsided, and it sheds twigs as it walks.

evolutions.hint: It carries a grove once it has grown, and only for a tamer it trusts.

species_review.name: Thornback
species_review.description: A walking grove. A young tree and a crown of thorns grow from its shoulders, the birds still nest, and flowers open where it steps.

species_review.name: Tidewyrm
species_review.description: A river dragon at last. The folded frill is a crest of fins, and it carries a ring of its own tide.

species_review.name: Tilthcrown
species_review.description: The loosened soil has become a planted bed it carries beside the shared paths.

species_review.name: Tilthtusk
species_review.description: It loosens worn soil beside shared paths, carefully circling the marked nursery beds.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, the loosened soil has become a planted bed it carries beside the shared paths.

species_review.name: Tumblecrown
species_review.description: The tumble in the headwind has become a crest that throws seed across the high meadow.

species_review.name: Tumbletusk
species_review.description: It rolls into a headwind, scattering seeds through the high meadows with every tumble.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, the tumble in the headwind has become a crest that throws seed across the high meadow.

species_review.name: Umbrelace
species_review.description: It hangs silk beside unsafe ledges, leaving the familiar passage open.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, the silk beside an unsafe ledge has become a veil that closes the bad path.

species_review.name: Undertone
species_review.description: Its low call passes through winding stone to guide separated groups back to one another.

species_review.name: Veilmote
species_review.description: A solitary mote folds deep shade around abandoned nests, keeping their last warmth through the night.

species_review.name: Ventmane
species_review.description: The copper fan of its tail has become a mane of steam over the warm vents.

species_review.name: Ventwhisk
species_review.description: It curls beside warm vents and fans little clouds of steam with its copper-coloured tail.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, the copper fan of its tail has become a mane of steam over the warm vents.

species_review.name: Watchlight
species_review.description: Farwatch Reach's guardian marks a safe approach through fog, waiting for travelers to answer before moving on.

species_review.name: Whisperpup
species_review.description: A small hound of Hollowecho Hills. Its ears are too big for its head, and it turns them until the wind in the stones matches a path.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, those ears catch the ridge wind.

species_review.name: Willowback
species_review.description: The seedlings in its back have taken root, and the bank holds where it rests.

species_review.name: Wrackjaw
species_review.description: Its rattling laugh echoes through driftwood piles as it cracks shellfish with pebble-hard jaws.

evolutions.hint: Once it trusts you and has grown, the pebble jaws that cracked shells now break the driftwood open for everyone smaller.

limits: Back file existence does not mean main renders it.
Species review rows expose descriptions and evolution lines; they do not grade originality or visual quality.
Graph/move checks do not prove every encounter, quest or save is valid; run the existing suites too.
